pattern.description: Semi-transparent cyan and blue diagonal bars drift along the diagonal at different speeds and opacities behind a static two-line headline, creating a sense of fast motion.
pattern.why_premium: Layered translucent bars moving at different rates give depth and a 'speed' feeling that reinforces the 'lightning speed' message while the headline stays perfectly legible.

build_hint.gsap: Several absolutely positioned skewed bars (rotate ~-30deg, mix-blend screen, opacity 0.2-0.6); gsap.to(bars, {x: '+=320', y: '-=180', duration: (i) => 1.2 + i * 0.4, ease: 'none', repeat: -1}) with per-bar speed and opacity variance; optional autoAlpha fades on entry/exit. Headline static.
build_hint.remotion: Map frame linearly to translate for each bar: x = interpolate(frame, [0, 60], [0, 320 * speed_i]), y = -x * 0.56, with different speed_i per bar layer; opacity per layer constant or interpolate for fade in/out. No spring (constant drift).

notes: Headline text (b03, b04) appears static; their changed_share comes from bars moving behind them. b02 is a sub-region of the same background motion, so not listed separately. Parallax vs simple drift is ambiguous.
